summary: Change adds pure helpers rememberShowdown/forgetSeats in src/engine/player-view.ts and wires them into runPlaytest (src/playtest/runner.ts). No new untrusted-input parsing, I/O, secrets, dependencies, randomness or logging. Hidden-card leak check: entries still come only from showdownOf, which copies state.result.showdown (shown hands only; mucked and folded hole cards never enter the list); forgetSeats only removes entries and rememberShowdown only appends that entry, so bots see no more than before and a replacement bot no longer inherits its predecessor's shown hands. Deep-freezing (list, entries, shown array, holeCards tuple) stops one seat policy from mutating what later views get. The limit is the constant EARLIER_SHOWDOWN_LIMIT=1000, so memory stays bounded. slice(-0) would keep every entry if limit were 0, but no input reaches the limit, so that is not worth a finding.
